"import cadquery as cq

# Define the XZ plane such that local (u, v) maps to global (u, 0, v).
# Achieved by setting the plane normal to -Y so that the local v-axis aligns with global +Z.
P = cq.Plane(origin=(0, 0, 0), xDir=(1, 0, 0), normal=(0, -1, 0))

# Local sketch coordinates (u, v) in millimetres
line1_start = (30, 0)
line1_end = (-6, -19)
line2_start = (-6, -19)
line2_end = (-30, 0)
spline_points = [(-30, 0), (-18, 30), (-6, 23), (6, 31), (18, 15), (30, 0)]

# Map local coordinates to 3D world coordinates
p_line1_start = P.toWorldCoords(line1_start)
p_line1_end = P.toWorldCoords(line1_end)
p_line2_start = P.toWorldCoords(line2_start)
p_line2_end = P.toWorldCoords(line2_end)
p_spline = [P.toWorldCoords(pt) for pt in spline_points]

# Create the three curve entities
edge_line1 = cq.Edge.makeLine(p_line1_start, p_line1_end)
edge_line2 = cq.Edge.makeLine(p_line2_start, p_line2_end)
edge_spline = cq.Edge.makeSpline(p_spline)

# Assemble into a compound of edges
edges = [edge_line1, edge_line2, edge_spline]
compound = cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges)

# Export to STEP file
cq.exporters.export(compound, "sketch.step")"
